stories.title: Can UK-Saudi ties become a security architecture for an unstable Gulf?

en.title: Can UK-Saudi ties become a security architecture for an unstable Gulf?
en.summary: A British official proposes that the UK-Saudi partnership should expand beyond traditional energy, defense, and trade cooperation to develop a broader security framework addressing Gulf instability and protecting global economic interests.

en.title: Saudi coffee reaffirms its authenticity as a cultural heritage on International Coffee Day
en.summary: Saudi Arabia celebrates International Coffee Day by highlighting coffee's significance in its culture, heritage, and national identity, particularly through agricultural production in southwestern highland regions.

en.title: Turkiye detains suspect in 2013 attack by Syria border: report
en.summary: Turkish intelligence detained a suspect connected to a 2013 bombing near the Syrian border that killed 53 people as he attempted to escape to Europe.

en.title: Saudi Coffee Celebrates Its Cultural Heritage on International Coffee Day
en.summary: Saudi Arabia marks International Coffee Day by recognizing coffee as an important element of its cultural and national heritage.

stories.title: Saudi coffee: A cup of hospitality, heritage and identity

en.title: Saudi coffee: A cup of hospitality, heritage and identity
en.summary: Saudi Arabia marks International Coffee Day by highlighting coffee's cultural significance in the kingdom. The beverage holds deep meaning in Saudi social traditions, hospitality practices, and heritage, traditionally offered to guests during social gatherings and family occasions.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia provides Yemen government with nearly $60m in budget support

en.title: Saudi Arabia provides Yemen government with nearly $60m in budget support
en.summary: Saudi Arabia has delivered over 224 million Saudi riyals in budget support to Yemen's government. The financial assistance comes amid ongoing tensions between Saudi Arabia and Houthi forces in Yemen.

stories.title: US beef sales in Saudi Arabia could reach $150 million

en.title: US beef sales in Saudi Arabia could reach $150 million
en.summary: The US and Saudi Arabia are expanding agricultural trade cooperation, with American producers showcasing beef, walnuts, potatoes and popcorn at the Saudi Food Show in Jeddah. The two countries are exploring opportunities to increase food exports and strengthen their agricultural relationship.

en.summary: Race driver Colapinto accepted complete responsibility for a crash that occurred in Baku while facing criticism on social media platforms.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia projects 2027 budget deficit at 3.6% of GDP

en.title: Saudi Arabia projects 2027 budget deficit at 3.6% of GDP
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Finance announced the 2027 budget with projected expenditures of 1.392 trillion riyals and revenues of 1.202 trillion riyals, resulting in a deficit of 3.6 percent of GDP. The fiscal plan aims to support economic growth while maintaining sustainability.

stories.title: ‎Thimar files with CMA for capital hike via rights issue

en.title: Thimar files with CMA for capital hike via rights issue
en.summary: Thimar Development Holding Co. submitted an application to Saudi Arabia's Capital Market Authority to increase its capital by 130 million riyals through a rights issue. The company aims to support financial restructuring, strengthen liquidity and meet its obligations.

en.title: Raydan raises proposed capital cut to 80%
en.summary: Raydan Food Co. increased its proposed capital reduction to 80% from 70%, reducing capital from 73.14 million to 14.63 million riyals due to accumulated losses. The reduction aims to restructure the company.

en.summary: Arabian Pipes Company has secured steel pipe manufacturing and supply contracts valued at approximately SAR 103 million from Saudi Aramco, with a 10-month duration and financial impact expected in Q2 and Q3 2027.
